blocks.text: NEW YORK–The NBA told sportsbook partners in a Friday memo to ban certain types of bets and parlays this season that gamblers used in recent wagering scandals, ESPN reported. The prohibition includes a player prop parlay and bets on “under” for players that were part of federal gambling cases that included NBA players Terry Rozier and Jontay Porter, according to the report.
